prompt: One square detailed painterly naturalistic folklore encyclopedia illustration of Inugami, a Japanese dog spirit. ONE spectral DOG, in ordinary canine form rather than an invented human dog hybrid. Lean medium-sized Japanese village dog with pointed ears, long muzzle, four natural dog legs, one curled tail and dark charcoal fur, standing alert in front of a dim old rural Japanese house. Its edges faintly dissolve into low mist to suggest a spirit, while face, paws and torso remain clearly canine. Full body and tail comfortably framed. Ominous moonlit shadow, intensely watchful stern eyes, a hint of restrained growl, eerie dangerous spiritual presence expressing the feared possession aspect of the lore; not a cute friendly pet, not cartoon, not a benevolent sun god. No people, no blood or injury, no ritual violence, no severed parts, no armor, robes, jewelry, horns, wings, weapons, extra tails or legs. This is an interpretive depiction of a dog spirit, not a fixed iconography claim. Rich painted realistic fur and wood textures. No text or watermark.

Subtle spectral edges in rural Japanese setting
